name: Accordion
description: A vertically stacked set of interactive headings that each reveal an associated section of content. Built on @radix-ui/react-accordion with animated expand/collapse transitions and a chevron indicator.

props.name: type
props.description: Determines whether one or multiple items can be opened at the same time. Inherited from Radix AccordionPrimitive.Root.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: When type is 'single', allows closing content when clicking the trigger of an open item.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value of the item(s) to expand.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The default value of the item(s) to expand when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Event handler called when the expanded state of an item changes.

props.name: disabled
props.description: When true, prevents the user from interacting with the accordion and all its items.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes applied to AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, or AccordionContent wrappers.

subComponents.name: AccordionItem
subComponents.description: Wraps a single collapsible section. Renders with a bottom border by default.

props.name: value
props.description: A unique string value for the item, used to control open/close state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: When true, prevents the user from interacting with this item.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes merged via cn().

subComponents.name: AccordionTrigger
subComponents.description: The clickable heading that toggles the associated content. Displays a ChevronDown icon that rotates 180 degrees when the item is open.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes merged via cn().

subComponents.name: AccordionContent
subComponents.description: The collapsible content area revealed when its parent AccordionItem is expanded. Uses animate-accordion-up/down for smooth transitions.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes applied to the inner div wrapper.

accessibility.role: Uses native Radix accordion roles: the root has no explicit role; each trigger has role='button' inside a heading element; content regions use role='region' with aria-labelledby pointing to the trigger.
accessibility.keyboard: Space/Enter toggles the focused trigger. Arrow Up/Down moves focus between triggers. Home/End moves to first/last trigger.
accessibility.aria: aria-expanded on triggers reflects open state. aria-controls on triggers references the content id. aria-labelledby on content references the trigger id.
accessibility.notes: Radix handles all ARIA attributes automatically. The component follows the WAI-ARIA Accordion Pattern.

examples.title: Single collapsible accordion
examples.code:
<Accordion type="single" collapsible>
  <AccordionItem value="item-1">
    <AccordionTrigger>Is it accessible?</AccordionTrigger>
    <AccordionContent>Yes. It adheres to the WAI-ARIA design pattern.</AccordionContent>
  </AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem value="item-2">
    <AccordionTrigger>Is it styled?</AccordionTrigger>
    <AccordionContent>Yes. It comes with default styles matching the Traxion design system.</AccordionContent>
  </AccordionItem>
</Accordion>

examples.title: Multiple items open simultaneously
examples.code:
<Accordion type="multiple" defaultValue={["item-1", "item-2"]}>
  <AccordionItem value="item-1">
    <AccordionTrigger>Section One</AccordionTrigger>
    <AccordionContent>Content for section one.</AccordionContent>
  </AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem value="item-2">
    <AccordionTrigger>Section Two</AccordionTrigger>
    <AccordionContent>Content for section two.</AccordionContent>
  </AccordionItem>
</Accordion>
